title: Broccoli & Cheddar Quiche
description: A cozy, family-friendly quiche with tender broccoli and plenty of cheddar in a flaky pie crust.

ingredients.item: small broccoli florets, fresh or frozen

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Cook the broccoli just until barely tender, then drain it very well and chop any large pieces.
Spread broccoli and cheddar evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

COOK until barely tender, then drain very well:
{{broccoli}} broccoli florets

SPREAD IN CRUST:
{{broccoli}} broccoli
{{cheddar}} cheddar cheese

WHISK TOGETHER:
{{eggs}} eggs
{{milk}} milk
{{salt}} salt
{{pepper}} black pepper

Pour over filling.
BAKE at 375°F until the center is set.
LET REST before slicing.

storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Reheat individual slices until hot.

title: Bacon, Onion & Cheddar Quiche
description: Smoky bacon, soft onion, and sharp cheddar baked into a rich, familiar quiche.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Cook bacon until crisp. Remove it, then soften the onion in a little of the bacon drippings.
Spread bacon, onion, and cheddar evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Spinach & Feta Quiche
description: A tangy vegetarian quiche with spinach, feta, and a little garlic.

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed very dry

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Warm olive oil in a skillet and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds. Stir in the very dry spinach just to warm it.
Spread spinach and feta evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Potato, Onion & Cheddar Quiche
description: A hearty meatless quiche with tender potato, soft onion, and cheddar cheese.

ingredients.item: russet potato, peeled and cut in small cubes

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Boil the potato cubes just until tender, about 5 minutes, then drain very well.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook the onion until softened.
Spread potato, onion, and cheddar evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.
